card.name: Connecting words in running prose
card.fires_on: No shared pattern. It fires on scattered small words such as consisting, the, and, were, be, or a period in unrelated general web prose, most strongly in a passage describing tabernacle curtains.

modes.label: Tabernacle curtain description
modes.description: Linking word or punctuation inside a passage about curtains, loops and cubits.
modes.example: Next came a covering of goat hair,<< consisting>> of eleven curtains, each thirty cubits

modes.label: Auxiliary verbs before a participle
modes.description: Words like were or be that come right before a verb such as able or saved.
modes.example: They would<< be>> saved by faithfully waiting for Jesus to appear
